new_value: Defined local-fact issuer-seq continuity across gateway restart in spec/06-security.md 8.13.1 (new 'Sequence continuity across restart' text after the Validity paragraph). Decision (a)+(b) resolved together: the issuer MUST persist its lichen:seq counter to NVS (resume strictly above highest issued) or use a non-regressing monotonic source, and verifiers MUST retain the per-issuer seq cache for as long as the issuer's key is trusted — they move together, so a restarted gateway's higher-seq fact supersedes pre-restart facts with no availability deadlock. Facts-vs-seq-cache distinction drawn explicitly against the 'invalidates cached facts' line. Dependency note: b4fu's freshness text (lichen:seq/expiry claims) lives on unmerged beads-worker-3 ca2f9161d9; I applied the amendment on main (cherry-pick 42c86484c5), which has the same Validity anchor text, so it lands cleanly and the driver rebases b4fu past it. Identical content also on scratch branch xeli-seq-restart (based at ca2f9161d9) as an alternate landing path. 3x codereview + convergence (kimi-k3 via opencode): pass1 correctness = 2 findings (self-unsatisfiable uptime-counter example; verifier durability scoped to issuer-restart only) fixed; pass2 security = 2 findings (GPS-spoof monotonic deadlock -> added max(floor+1, time-derived) clamp + 8-byte floor; paired-reset bootstrap replay -> SHOULD-expiry bound) fixed; pass3 edge = opencode timed out x2, worker model: 1 finding (MUST-expiry contradicted b4fu's optional-freshness model) -> softened to SHOULD with mesh-lifetime caveat; convergence = opencode timed out, worker model: all fixed, cross-refs/tie-rule coherent, PASS. Residual out-of-scope issue (verifier-side GPS spoof re-admits revoked fact, rooted in b4fu's freshness text not this paragraph) filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-4egy.
